cases.name: wr552_horn_torus_snapped_m0
cases.note: The snapped horn torus (major = minor, the port's analytic_revolution with the opt-in). WR-552 (fork c4e378d): the torus a whole turn of the arc of radius 10 + 1e-10 about (10, 0), ending on the Y axis, sweeps. The arc stops sqrt(2 R 1e-10) short of the apex height, so the V boundary circle there has a radius of about 1e-10: the port's check fails SmSurface test #5 (approximately but not exactly singular) on it; this compares SMLib's.
